components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action with Ledger Orange and a visible keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #ea580c; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 600 0.92rem/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #c2410c; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: #fff; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 500 0.9rem/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f5f5f4; border-color: #d6d3d1; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Full-width field with a clear orange focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Vendor name" aria-label="Vendor name" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; background: #fff; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 0.9rem/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #78716c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #ea580c; outline: 3px solid rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.2); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact text-led receipt status with a semantic tint.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; border: 1px solid #059669; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel calm, trustworthy, and structured, with the warmth of a practical finance tool rather than a cold enterprise template. Geist Variable keeps expense information direct and easy to scan. Ledger Orange is the action accent; neutral surfaces carry the working content. The code contains both a legacy indigo layer and a newer orange layer; orange is the chosen primary for future work. The preferred depth language is flat, using borders and tonal surfaces first and minimizing shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Orange actions against calm neutral surfaces
Clear status colors with text labels

rules.name: The Status-Has-a-Label Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a status; the status text remains visible and understandable without color.

rules.name: The Scan-First Rule
rules.body: Keep amounts, statuses, and vendor names visually distinct from supporting metadata.

dos: Use Ledger Orange as the primary accent for future surfaces.
Use warm neutral surfaces and thin borders to organize expense information.
Pair semantic status colors with plain status text.
Preserve visible focus states and adapt navigation and grids for smaller screens.
donts: Don't extend the legacy indigo accent into new components.
Don't use shadows as the default separator between cards.
Don't make status meaning depend on color alone.
Don't add decorative display typography that competes with receipt data.
